title: USB 5V→3.3V supply
prompt: Design a printed circuit board that takes 5V from a USB connector and regulates it to 3.3V with a linear regulator. Required components: USB connector, LDO regulator, input capacitor, output capacitor, and a power-indicator LED with its resistor — at least five footprints. Board outline at most 40mm × 25mm, two copper layers. Declare nets VBUS, 3V3, and GND; place components and route every net so its copper is fully connected, with input/output capacitors electrically adjacent to the regulator pins. The board must pass a design-rule check clean. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
